sections.heading: Run the Repository Ledger Census Test in the Default Profile Only
sections.key: h1:run the repository ledger census test in the default profile only

counterexample_or_failure_condition: the approval predates an affected repair or is not independently grounded
expected: the approving actor independently verifies the current affected scope
known_bad_detection_method: The current tree's second-profile qualification log records the census test erroring with FileNotFoundError on set.md for a real repository ledger; readiness attests to plan and tree review, not to the unimplemented marker.
limitations: Approval remains scoped to the recorded actor and affected review boundary.
observed: default_profile_only (record_layout_support.py) on a method returns _MarkedTest, whose __set_name__ installs a skipping wrapper and wraps the inherited _ServedLedger.setUp, so the skip fires before setUp; _skip_unless_shipped_profile raises SkipTest only when profile_differences() is non-empty, so the default profile still runs the test. Precedent test_review_policy.py test_carrier_boundary_census_reports_its_own_transition_cost uses the same form. second.log shows exactly one ERROR, FileNotFoundError at line 442 (RECORD_FILENAME resolves to set.md for a real repository ledger); line 442 is the only RECORD_FILENAME use in the file, and other repository reads (SurfaceCensusTests) do not depend on record names and passed. AC-1 and AC-2 are testable via the second qualification, --compare, and the default full suite with a fresh receipt.
proposition: code-reviewer approves the current affected scope
safety_and_authorization: Local review evidence only; no external side effects.

observed: Prepare-phase Wave Council PASS (moderator: council-chair; primer-depth: standard; seats: red-team, security-reviewer; rotating-seat: security-reviewer; strongest-challenge: the skip also removes the second-profile run of check_wave_docs(REPO_ROOT) in the same test, but that call surveys this repository's default-profile records too, so it was never a meaningful second-profile check; strongest-alternative: resolve the record name from the frozen shipped default instead of skipping, rejected because the tests avoid literal record names and default_profile_only is the documented convention for censuses of this repository's documents, as in test_review_policy.py). red-team: second.log shows exactly one FAILED file and errors=1 for test_security_unsettled_disposition.py (32 tests, failures=0), the FileNotFoundError on docs/waves/1seax.../set.md at line 442 (vocabulary_profile.RECORD_FILENAME); every other test in the file passed under the second profile, so no further change is needed. default_profile_only works on a method via _MarkedTest.__set_name__ (wraps the method, sets __default_profile_only__, skips before setUp), existing method use at test_review_policy.py:2242; qualification_worker.py:56-58 reads the method marker, and qualification_report.py --compare accepts an extra second-profile skip only when the marker is set and the reason starts 'default-profile-only: <marker> (loaded ' and ends ' differ from the shipped defaults)', the exact form _skip_unless_shipped_profile raises. Note for implementer: the file does not yet import record_layout_support; add 'from record_layout_support import default_profile_only'. No findings. security-reviewer: test-only edit, no shipped code, release gate logic in qualification_report.py and the package prompt step 5 unchanged; the skip is accepted only through the existing marker contract, so gate integrity is unaffected. No findings.
